contribution: If the baseline was already good, what research value did the refinement add?
why_lime: What did LIME contribute when the final accuracy gain was not significant?
lime_vs_gain: If XGBoost gives gain importance for free, why add a separate LIME explanation step?
why_xgboost: What made a boosted-tree classifier appropriate for daily Bandung weather data?
why_binary: Why did you predict whether it rains instead of the number of millimeters?
threshold_rain: What changes if a rainy day is defined above or below half a millimeter?
dataset: What is the source and time span of the daily observations used here?
single_station: Would the same feature ranking hold at a different weather station?
split: Did you keep later dates entirely separate from the dates used for training?
holdout_small: How much confidence can we put in a gain measured on only 129 days?
missing_rr: Why remove days with missing rain measurements instead of filling them in?
horizon_misalignment: After missing days were removed, are all labels still exactly one day ahead?
leakage: Could any step in feature engineering or selection have leaked hold-out information?
unequal_paths: Is the LIME path a controlled comparison with the gain-importance path?
why_two_percent: Would your selected feature set change if the importance cutoff were one or three percent?
lime_aggregate: How can explanations for single days be combined into a dataset-wide feature ranking?
lime_stability: Did repeating LIME with different seeds give the same important features?
humidity: Why did relative humidity dominate the explanations, and is that a causal finding?
dewpoint: What was the physical motivation for dew point and dew point depression features?
cyclic: Why represent the annual calendar with two trigonometric values instead of a raw day number?
ablation: If cyclic encoding alone gives the same F one score, what improvement is really due to LIME?
performance: Can you summarize baseline versus Path A versus Path B performance on the final test period?
baseline_errors: Was the original classifier more likely to miss rain or issue false rain alerts?
f1_choice: What do F one and precision-recall area reveal that plain accuracy misses?
significance: Is the small Path A improvement statistically distinguishable from chance variation?
mcnemar: Why compare paired prediction errors with McNemar instead of comparing two accuracies alone?
cv: How did the forward-in-time validation folds preserve the order of days?
autocorrelation: Do correlated rainy days weaken the inference from a pooled paired test?
shap: Which findings came from this LIME paper and which came from the separate SHAP analysis?
case: What can we learn from the missed-rain example on December twenty-second?
future: What experiment would you run next to test whether these findings generalize?
ai_boosting: In simple terms, how do the successive X G Boost trees correct earlier mistakes?
ai_additive: Does the rain prediction come from one tree or the sum of many tree outputs?
ai_gradient_hessian: How are first and second derivatives used when XGBoost chooses a new split?
ai_training_objective: Which loss is minimized while the classifier is fitted, as opposed to its reported F one score?
ai_f1_nondifferentiable: How can F one guide model selection when it is not the differentiable training loss?
ai_gain_split: What does a large split gain actually say about the feature used in that split?
ai_importance_types: How would the ranking change if you counted splits rather than measuring gain?
ai_depth: What is the practical effect of limiting each boosted tree to depth three?
ai_learning_rate: Why use a very small learning rate while fitting hundreds of trees?
ai_subsample: What does an eighty-percent row subsample mean during XGBoost training?
ai_colsample: How does selecting eighty percent of columns per tree affect the ensemble?
ai_overfit: What comparison would show whether the boosted model memorized the training period?
ai_early_stopping: Was training stopped according to validation performance or a fixed tree count?
ai_xgb_missing: If boosted trees can route missing data, why fill weather gaps beforehand?
ai_tree_probability: How is a tree-ensemble score converted into a probability for tomorrow's rain?
ai_lime_acronym: What do the letters in LIME mean, and what does the method explain?
ai_lime_steps: What happens between choosing one weather day and receiving its LIME feature weights?
ai_lime_surrogate: Is the explanation itself another XGBoost model or a simpler local approximation?
ai_lime_kernel: Why should synthetic points near the explained day count more than distant points?
ai_lime_modelagnostic: Could LIME explain another classifier if we replaced XGBoost?
ai_lime_perturbation: Can randomly generated LIME weather cases be physically impossible?
ai_lime_bins: Why cut continuous measurements into quartiles in the LIME explanation?
ai_lime_weight_sign: Does a positive LIME weight push a particular prediction toward rain or away from it?
ai_lime_abs: Why take absolute explanation weights before averaging across observations?
ai_lime_samples: What was the reason for generating five thousand synthetic neighbors per explanation?
ai_lime_seed: Can changing LIME's random seed change which predictors appear most important?
ai_lime_vs_shap: What distinction should we make between a local LIME surrogate and TreeSHAP values?
ai_precision_formula: Among all predicted rain days, what fraction actually had rain?
ai_recall_formula: Among all actual rain days, what fraction did the classifier detect?
ai_f1_formula: How do you combine precision and recall into the harmonic-mean F one measure?
ai_aucpr_roc: Why report both precision-recall area and ROC area for the same rain model?
ai_threshold_vs_auc: How can F one rise at the chosen cutoff while overall ranking area falls?
ai_mcnemar_table: What are the two off-diagonal counts in a paired McNemar comparison?
ai_holm_steps: What happens to significance when three p-values receive a Holm adjustment?
ai_timeseries_split: Why would randomly shuffling consecutive weather days give misleading validation?
ai_nested_cv: What bias would nested time-series cross-validation help remove?
ai_cv_mean_vs_pooled: Why is a mean of sixteen fold F one scores different from one pooled score?
ai_bagging_boosting: How do sequentially corrected trees differ from independently averaged trees?
ai_permutation_importance: What extra evidence could permutation importance provide beyond LIME and tree gain?
ai_error_costs: Should a missed rain event count the same as an unnecessary rain warning?
